review.notes: Full review. The 15 sampled targets and every other locator into Connes 1982, Connes 1994, Kordyukov, Crainic-Moerdijk, Hilsum-Skandalis, Laca-Neshveyev and Neshveyev were read against the texts (all at the cited pages); Muhly-Williams and Sims-Williams were not reopened. Both findings are in Fo3.2: a Check that denies a Morita equivalence which exists, and a Hausdorffness equivalence missing the hypothesis that the transversal is complete. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; targeted build succeeds with 11 sorry warnings; one-tactic probe and #check signature pass run on a scratch copy; supplier sections resolved on main and at the open head of TracesOnCStarAlgebras; no overlap with another roadmap.
